incidents.name: WXETA
incidents.notes: unprotected initialize plus public mint on WXeta diamond minted unlimited tokens

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x05c2dd9cf547c6cccf91245346e6e1bc9926cae7 is an EIP-2535 diamond that installs code with DiamondCut and emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event; eth_getLogs over creation block 36918555 to incident block 42284162 finds exactly two DiamondCut logs, the deployment cut (2024-03-13T00:21:55Z) and a second cut at block 36927327, 2024-03-13T07:41:33Z, tx 0xe62285b2153aca90950043f507babe523ec3b0fc3dc3f8069a8e4de803285543, which Added facet 0x7c83dc9221cfd48ac760710b7f1cd7b76ff6fcc2 with the 15 ERC20/token selectors including initialize(uint256) 0xfe4b84df and mint(address,uint256) 0x40c10f19 - the exact pair the exploit used - so the flawed code dates from that cut, 7h20m after deployment

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2024-03-13T07:41:33Z (block 36927327, tx 0xe62285b2153aca90950043f507babe523ec3b0fc3dc3f8069a8e4de803285543): DiamondCut that Added facet 0x7c83dc9221cfd48ac760710b7f1cd7b76ff6fcc2, installing initialize(uint256) (0xfe4b84df) and mint(address,uint256) (0x40c10f19) - the unprotected initialize and public mint the exploit called
